title: Plan Months by Size of Principal — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Schedule
content:
For a new repayment plan on Benefit Overpayment Accounts, the plan months follow the size of the principal established on the overpayment: the total of the principal assessed on the overpayment's ledger.

| Principal established | Plan months |
|---|---|
| Up to USD 1500.00 (the small-principal cap) | The small-principal share, 0.5 (50 percent), of the classification's maximum plan months |
| Above USD 1500.00 and up to USD 5000.00 (the mid-principal cap) | The mid-principal share, 0.75 (75 percent), of the classification's maximum plan months |
| Above USD 5000.00 | The classification's maximum plan months in full |

Each share is counted in whole months, with any fraction of a month dropped.

## Schedule by classification

| Classification | Maximum plan months | Principal up to USD 1500.00 | Above USD 1500.00 up to USD 5000.00 | Above USD 5000.00 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 60 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 60 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 60 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 48 | 24 | 36 | 48 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 36 | 18 | 27 | 36 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 24 | 12 | 18 | 24 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical principals)

- USD 1500.00 falls in the first row; USD 1500.01 falls in the second.
- USD 5000.00 falls in the second row; USD 5000.01 falls in the third.
- The figure compared is the principal established, not the balance due and not the principal still unpaid.
